question: In a Full Lap joint, diagonal pitch is given by________, where pd -diagonal pitch, p- pitch, d-diameter of rivets
solution:
The correct answer is __pd = (2p+d)3" id="MathJax-Element-3-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">(2p+d)3(2p+d)3

__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diagonal pitch__ in a Full Lap joint is a calculated parameter.
 
• The formula for diagonal pitch is pd = (2p+d)3" id="MathJax-Element-4-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">(2p+d)3(2p+d)3
 \frac{(2p + d)}{3}
 , where:
 
• p is the pitch of rivets.
 
• d is the diameter of rivets.
 
• This formula ensures proper rivet spacing and joint strength.
 
• Correct diagonal pitch minimizes stress concentration and improves load distribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rivet Joints:**

 
 
• Rivet joints are widely used in structural applications.
 
• They provide a secure connection for overlapping plates.
 
 
 
• **Lap Joint:**
 
 
• A lap joint involves overlapping two plates and fastening them using rivets.
 
• Full Lap joints are commonly used in engineering applications for their strength.
